ZW.sources_add: Finance Act [Chapter 23:04], Income Tax Act [Chapter 23:06] and VAT Act [Chapter 23:12] as updated by ZIMRA to 1 December 2024 (incorporating the Finance (No. 2) Act 7 of 2024 amendments from 1 January 2025), from zimra.co.zw/legislation/17-acts (`cmp20/global/R4/fetch/zw8/`, SHA256SUMS).

cit.name: Corporate income tax
cit.statute: Finance Act [Chapter 23:04] s. 14 (2) (c) and Schedule to Chapter I Part II (taxable income of a company or trust 25 %), ZIMRA consolidation to 1 December 2024 incl. the Finance (No. 2) Act 2024 changes from 1 January 2025; the Finance Act 2025 does not amend s. 14 (2) (c)
cit.doc: Finance Act s. 14 (2): "the income tax with which a person is chargeable in the year of assessment beginning on the 1st January, 2012 or any subsequent year of assessment shall be calculated ... (c) in the case of a company or a trust ... at the specified percentage"; Schedule to Chapter I, Part II (Current rates of income tax on taxable income, "Substituted by the FINANCE ACT -/2024"): "14(2)(c) Taxable income of company or trust 25" (the same 25 % in the 2024 table; 24 % appears only in the tables substituted by Act 10/2020). ZIMRA's corporate 'Tax rates' page: "Income of company or trust 14(2c) 25% ... Aids Levy: Rate is based on tax chargeable 3%".
notes: the AIDS levy (3 % of the income tax chargeable, imposed outside the Finance Act) is not modelled: the effective rate would be 25,75 %
licensed investors, mining, BOOT/BOT, special economic zones and export-manufacturing rates (s. 14 (2) (e)-(j), 14 (3)) are not modelled

wht.name: Non-residents' taxes
wht.statute: Finance Act [Chapter 23:04] s. 15 (c) (non-resident shareholders' tax 15 % on unlisted dividends), s. 19 (non-residents' tax on fees 15 %, substituted from 1 January 2025), s. 21 (non-residents' tax on royalties 15 %), ZIMRA consolidation to 1 December 2024
wht.doc: s. 15: "The non-resident shareholders' tax ... shall be calculated (a) ... listed ... at the rate of 10%; (b) ... Victoria Falls Stock Exchange ... 5%; (c) in the case of any other dividend, at the rate of 15%"; s. 19 ("repealed and substituted by Act -/2024 w.e.f. 1st January, 2025"): "The non-residents' tax on fees ... shall be calculated at the rate of 15% of each dollar of the fees" (10 % for licensed investors); s. 21: "The non-residents' tax on royalties ... shall be calculated at the rate of 15% of each dollar of the royalty".
notes: listed dividends are at 10 % (5 % on the Victoria Falls Stock Exchange): the company's dividend is taken as unlisted; interest paid to non-residents bears no non-residents' tax (not modelled as a charge)
non-residents' tax on remittances (15 %, s. 20) on branch remittances not modelled
